d.ko: Warfare 1917 and 1944 return, fully remastered with enhanced visuals, full-screen support, and custom battles. Warfare Legacy Collection also Includes the Battle of the Bulge, a brand-new campaign set during WWII’s final offensive with all-new missions, snowy maps, and intense front-line action.

d.zh: 游玩完整重置版本的《Warfare 1917》与《Warfare 1944》，体验进一步提升的画面、全屏幕支持与自定义战斗。《Warfare Legacy Collection》还包含了以第二次世界大战最终攻势为背景的新战役“突出部之役”，为玩家带来全新的任务、雪天地图以及紧张激烈的前线激战。
